When he was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Lannik (species)/Legends|Lannik]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] constructed a small green bladed '''lightsaber''', to match his small size. As a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]], Piell would frequently use the lightsaber in battle.

==History==
During the [[Yinchorri Uprising]] of [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] wielded a [[Color/Legends|red]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in [[Raid on the Jedi Temple (Yinchorri Uprising)|defense]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="JC2" />

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Piell joined [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]] to [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] for peace negotiations. Here, Even would brandish his weapon when [[Hutar Zash]] attempted to assassinate the Jedi. Piell emerged victorious, and also defeated the [[Red Iaro/Legends|Red Iaro]] members that Zash wished to get support from.

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Piell was part of the Jedi strike team led by Mace Windu in an effort to save [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] from [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. Along with his Padawan, [[Jax Pavan]], Piell used his green lightsaber to battle countless battle droids dispatched by Dooku. The battle sparked the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and Piell would be on the front lines using his lightsaber to win many battles for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

Approximately four [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Piell used a blue-bladed lightsaber during Skywalker's [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|knighting ceremony]].<ref name="CW" />

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Piell was on a mission in the Outer Rim with his captain, [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] to recover secret [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] lane coordinates called the [[Nexus Route/Legends|Nexus Route]], which were of a great importance. His cruiser fell under enemy [[Capture of Even Piell/Legends|attack]] and Piell wielded his lightsaber in an effort to defeat the droids, but was captured and taken to the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]]. He was soon freed by Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker and Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and recovered his small shoto-like lightsaber. Piell fought valiantly with his weapon, until an [[Anooba/Legends|anooba]] beast mortally wounded Piell. He managed to give the coordinates of the Route to Tano before he died. His lightsaber was returned to the Jedi Temple.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The color of Even Piell's lightsaber is inconsistent between issues of the [[Star Wars: Emissaries to Malastare|''Star Wars: Republic: Emissaries to Malastare'']] storyline: its blade is pink in the [[Star Wars (1998) 14|second issue]],<ref name="SW14">[[Star Wars (1998) 14|''Star Wars'' (1998) 14]]</ref> purple in the [[Star Wars (1998) 15|third]],<ref name="SW15">[[Star Wars (1998) 15|''Star Wars'' (1998) 15]]</ref> and red in the [[Star Wars (1998) 16|fourth]].<ref name="SW16">[[Star Wars (1998) 16|''Star Wars'' (1998) 16]]</ref>
